table_title: PARTICLE-SIZE DISTRIBUTION OF SUSPENDED SEDIMENT, WATER YEAR OCTOBER 1972 TO SEPTEMBER 1973
site_name: BLACK BUTTE RIVER NEAR COVELO, CALIF.
quantities_units: temperature (deg C); instantaneous discharge (cfs); suspended sediment (mg/L); suspended sediment discharge (t/day); suspended sediment fall diameter % finer than .002, .004, .008, .016, .031, .062 mm (percent)
notes: Site heading is at the top of the page (a continued station); it gives number and name only. The station description with latitude and longitude is on an earlier page and was not looked up; the only location words on this page are those in the station name. Rows printed here run Oct. 15 to Jan. 16 (no year in the rows; title says water year October 1972 to September 1973), so the rows on this page are 1972 to January 1973. The table may continue on the next page. Water type is a judgement: sediment samples at a stream gauging station (it includes instantaneous discharge). A third block on the page (sieve diameters, same dates) is the continuation of this table to the right; I took table 2 to be the first block.
